arStrings.szText: "You called the Sightless Eye a mistake. Why?"

Philios gathered the Eye’s vessel, and I lent my foresight to shape it. The Eye was made so we may communicate between realms. I feared the High Heavens would sense Sanctuary by us using the Eye, so I urged Philios to hide it.

I did not foresee that my gift would transfer to mortals. More than once, I thought of reclaiming it. Yet humankind was made for longing—the endless hunger to know. Whether that restraint was insightful or foolish, ask Wisdom himself.
